description_en: Call GetAsyncErrorRequestStatResult to asynchronously get the execution error count for a specific SQL statement from the SQL Insight results of a database instance
description_zh: 调用GetAsyncErrorRequestStatResult接口，异步获取数据库实例SQL洞察结果中指定SQL的执行错误次数
name: GetAsyncErrorRequestStatResult

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the node.

This parameter is required for PolarDB for MySQL instances
parameters.help_zh:
节点ID。

对于PolarDB MySQL版实例，需要提供节点ID
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en: One or more SQL IDs. Separate multiple SQL IDs with commas. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/410746.html operation to query the SQL IDs that generated MySQL error codes on the instance
parameters.help_zh: SQL ID，多个SQL ID请使用英文逗号分隔。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/410746.html接口查询实例中产生MySQL错误码的SQL ID
parameters.name: sql_id_list

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the query, specified as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

The start time must be within the data retention period of SQL Explorer for the database instance. The start time cannot be earlier than 90 days before the current time
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒。

查询开始时间需在数据库实例SQL洞察存储时长范围内，最大不能早于当前时间90天
parameters.name: start

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the query, specified as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

The end time must be later than the start time. The interval between the start time and the end time cannot exceed 1 day
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒。

查询结束时间需晚于查询开始时间，且查询开始时间和查询结束时间的间隔不能超过1天
parameters.name: end

complete.description_en:
Indicates whether the asynchronous request is complete.

true: The request is complete.

false: The request is in progress
complete.description_zh:
异步请求是否完成：

true：是。

false：否

fail.description_en:
Indicates whether the request failed.

true: The request failed.

false: The request succeeded
fail.description_zh:
请求是否失败：

true：是。

false：否

isFinish.description_en:
Indicates whether the asynchronous request is complete.

true: The request is complete.

false: The request is in progress
isFinish.description_zh:
异步请求是否执行完成：

true：是。

false：否

additionalProperties.description_en: The details of a data entry
additionalProperties.description_zh: 异步请求的返回数据列表

result.description_en: The data returned by the asynchronous request
result.description_zh: 异步请求的返回数据列表

state.description_en:
The state of the asynchronous request. Valid values:

RUNNING: The request is running.

SUCCESS: The request succeeded.

FAIL: The request failed
state.description_zh:
异步请求的执行状态：

RUNNING：正在运行。

SUCCESS：成功。

FAIL：失败

timestamp.description_en: The time when the asynchronous request was complete. The time is a Unix timestamp in milliseconds
timestamp.description_zh: 执行时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒

Message.description_en:
The response message.

If the request succeeds, this parameter returns Successful. If the request fails, this parameter returns an error message
Message.description_zh:
请求返回消息。

请求成功时该参数返回Successful，请求失败时会返回请求异常信息（如错误码等）

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful.

true: The request was successful.

false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否执行成功：

true：执行成功。

false：执行失败
